queries.name: original_prices
queries.title: Complete original published prices
queries.note: Every published price row and original column. The price key is name; repeated paths retain the publisher's distinct price tiers. Amounts are GBP and original period/display wording is preserved.

queries.name: original_catalogue
queries.title: Complete original service catalogue
queries.note: Every service, consultancy and charity catalogue row, with its original description, section and canonical URL.

queries.name: price_catalogue
queries.title: Prices joined to the original catalogue
queries.sql: SELECT p.*, c.{{column:catalog:slug}} AS catalogue_slug, c.{{column:catalog:title}} AS catalogue_title, c.{{column:catalog:section}} AS catalogue_section, c.{{column:catalog:url}} AS catalogue_url, CASE WHEN c.{{column:catalog:url}} IS NULL THEN 'not-listed-in-catalogue' ELSE 'catalogued' END AS catalogue_match, CASE WHEN p.{{column:prices:charity_amount_gbp}} IS NULL OR TRIM(p.{{column:prices:charity_amount_gbp}}) = '' THEN 'unpublished' WHEN p.{{column:prices:charity_amount_gbp}} IN (0, '0') THEN 'published-zero' ELSE 'published' END AS charity_rate_state FROM {{source:prices}} AS p LEFT JOIN {{source:catalog}} AS c ON c.{{column:catalog:url}} = 'https://elitedigitalagency.io' || p.{{column:prices:path}} ORDER BY p.{{column:prices:name}}
queries.note: The publisher's HTTPS origin plus each original price path is matched to the catalogue's canonical URL. Each price remains one row. An absent catalogue entry is retained explicitly. Blank charity rates remain unpublished and actual zero rates remain published-zero.

queries.name: catalogue_coverage
queries.title: Catalogue coverage by published price tiers
queries.sql: SELECT c.{{column:catalog:slug}} AS slug, c.{{column:catalog:title}} AS title, c.{{column:catalog:section}} AS section, c.{{column:catalog:url}} AS canonical_url, COUNT(p.{{column:prices:name}}) AS published_price_tiers FROM {{source:catalog}} AS c LEFT JOIN {{source:prices}} AS p ON c.{{column:catalog:url}} = 'https://elitedigitalagency.io' || p.{{column:prices:path}} GROUP BY c.{{column:catalog:slug}}, c.{{column:catalog:title}}, c.{{column:catalog:section}}, c.{{column:catalog:url}} ORDER BY c.{{column:catalog:section}}, c.{{column:catalog:url}}
queries.note: All catalogue entries remain present, including those with no published price. The price-tier count uses the price name key; related price paths are legitimate many-to-one joins.

queries.name: catalogue_review
queries.title: Original price records outside the catalogue
queries.sql: SELECT p.* FROM {{source:prices}} AS p WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM {{source:catalog}} AS c WHERE c.{{column:catalog:url}} = 'https://elitedigitalagency.io' || p.{{column:prices:path}}) ORDER BY p.{{column:prices:name}}
queries.note: These complete source records are available for review alongside the whole catalogue. The source publisher includes healthcare, care and tools outside the selected catalogue list.

queries.name: selected_period
queries.title: Selected original billing period
queries.sql: SELECT p.*, c.{{column:catalog:slug}} AS catalogue_slug, c.{{column:catalog:section}} AS catalogue_section FROM {{source:prices}} AS p LEFT JOIN {{source:catalog}} AS c ON c.{{column:catalog:url}} = 'https://elitedigitalagency.io' || p.{{column:prices:path}} WHERE p.{{column:prices:period}} = ? ORDER BY p.{{column:prices:name}}
queries.note: The request selects an original billing period: one-off, month or free. Published prices and from wording remain those of the source capture.
